corrections: OWNER REVIEW SURFACE: '?view=character-proof&set=real' is NOT authoritative for the OCD p76 despilled feminine bodies. CharacterProofView builds the 'real' set from CANDIDATE_REVIEW_CHARACTER_LIBRARY, which liftCandidatesForReview derives from character-component-candidate records; the OCD p76 chopped/despilled bodies are not registered as candidate components. Verified in-repo: 'ocd_body_' occurs 0 times in art/manifest/asset_manifest.json and 0 times in art/manifest/character_catalog.json. The authoritative owner surfaces are art/qa/contact_sheets/index.html (verified: 24 'ocd-p76/bodies-despilled' references covering all eight asset ids) and the files under art/generated/candidates/ocd-p76/bodies-despilled/*.png. The character-proof route stays valid for the candidate-review library it actually renders (the pg-modular bank).

ANCHOR GATE UNCHANGED: the owner may accept or reject the ART of the eight despilled poses now, but D-068 anchor acceptance occurs only AFTER a production-resolution re-export. The current undersized, to-be-re-exported raster must not receive authoritative anchors.

WAVE-A PIXELS INSPECTED: the earlier 'pixel-unreachable' claim is obsolete. All five Wave-A PNGs were downloaded and visually inspected outside this Claude session. Dimensions and per-sheet consequences are recorded in drive_only_assets.

WAVE-A DISPOSITION: the four 5056x3392 4x2 sheets yield ~1264x1696 cells, below the 1696x2528 production-body floor, so they are morphology/measurement input for #89 rather than production-release-ready body masters; baked desk/chair/lectern geometry in some cells requires per-pose disposition; the fat-female file carries three poses and is a supplement, not a complete 8-pose family.
